issues.description: Customers report their accounts being taken over by strangers, with changed emails, passwords, or personal details, and support failing to restore access or secure the account.
issues.name: Accounts hijacked and not recovered

issues.description: Customers report their accounts being accessed, taken over, or logged into from unknown locations, with some also losing playlists or account data and feeling their personal information is not adequately protected.
issues.name: Unauthorized account access and security concerns

issues.description: Users are logged out or unable to sign in, and then find their saved songs, playlists, and premium status missing or reset.
issues.name: Login failures causing account and library loss

issues.description: Customers repeatedly hit errors such as generic something-went-wrong or try-again messages when attempting to sign up or register, blocking account creation entirely.
issues.name: Users unable to sign up or create accounts

issues.description: Customers cannot sign in through their linked Facebook or Google accounts, getting errors, blank screens, crashes, or being locked out with no working alternative.
issues.name: Unable to log in via Facebook or Google

issues.description: Customers report being charged repeatedly, double charged, or billed after canceling or without authorization, and say refunds or cancellation were hard to obtain.
issues.name: Unwanted or duplicate charges after cancellation

issues.description: Users report being charged repeatedly or unexpectedly, and feel the app pushes payments that make it unaffordable or unusable.
issues.name: Unexpected charges and forced payments

issues.description: Free-tier users report they can no longer play chosen songs, seek, or skip freely without a premium subscription, and some report unexpected charges or inability to cancel.
issues.name: Core playback locked behind premium paywall

issues.description: Many users say recent Premium price increases, or charges at higher rates, make the subscription unaffordable, so they are cancelling or cutting back.
issues.name: Premium price increases users cannot afford

issues.description: Users are charged for Premium or subscription plans that either never activate, revert to a different plan, or keep renewing after cancellation, leaving them paying without the entitlement they bought.
issues.name: Charged for premium without access or cancellation

issues.description: Customers report that songs, albums, and library content have been removed or are unavailable, often alleging this is selective or politically motivated.
issues.name: Missing or deleted songs and albums

issues.description: Users report that song lyrics no longer load or appear in the app, even after reinstalling or updating, making a core feature unusable.
issues.name: Lyrics fail to load or display

issues.description: Customers report that songs and podcasts they previously could play or search for are removed, greyed out, or shown as unavailable.
issues.name: Songs and podcasts missing or unavailable

issues.description: Users report that the app plays suggested or random tracks instead of the songs they search for or select, and recommendations feel repetitive, irrelevant, or inappropriate.
issues.name: Requested songs replaced by unwanted recommendations

issues.description: Users report that searching for songs or artists returns no results, blank or gray screens, unavailable messages, or crashes instead of playable music.
issues.name: Search fails to return or load songs

issues.description: Users report that downloaded songs, libraries, and liked songs vanish unexpectedly, often after updates, offline use, or subscription lapses, and cannot be restored easily.
issues.name: Downloaded music disappearing from library

issues.description: Users report the app downloading content without consent, consuming mobile data and battery despite restrictive settings, and deleting or losing previously downloaded songs and playlists.
issues.name: Unexpected downloads and lost offline content

issues.description: Customers report that saved songs, downloads, and library contents vanish or cannot be recovered, often after an app update or storage change.
issues.name: Downloaded songs and library disappearing after updates

issues.description: Customers who paid for offline listening report that offline mode will not load, downloaded songs disappear or get re-downloaded, and playback breaks without internet access.
issues.name: Offline mode and downloads fail or erase music

issues.description: Many reviewers believe the app collects, leaks, or sells personal data without consent, and some report it behaves like malware or scam software.
issues.name: Privacy concerns and data misuse fears

issues.description: Users report the app repeatedly glitching, freezing, lagging, or buffering, which stops songs from playing or cuts them short and sometimes causes data or playlist loss.
issues.name: App glitches, buffering and playback failures

issues.description: Users report music playback stopping, starting unexpectedly, or failing to connect to cars, Bluetooth, and other devices, and the app falsely showing offline or no-internet errors despite working networks.
issues.name: Playback and connectivity failures across devices

issues.description: Users report the app crashing, freezing, or shutting off during playback, often causing downloaded music or playlists to be lost and requiring reinstalls.
issues.name: App crashes and freezes during playback

issues.description: Users report playback that won't start, stops mid-song, or begins on its own without input, often accompanied by unresponsive controls or black screens.
issues.name: Music playback fails or starts unexpectedly

issues.description: Users report the app closing, freezing on launch, or failing to play audio after updates or storage changes, and reinstalling or clearing cache does not resolve it.
issues.name: App crashes, freezes, and fails to play after updates

issues.description: Users report music and podcasts stopping, pausing, or refusing to start mid-listen, often requiring app restarts or reinstalls to recover.
issues.name: Playback stops or pauses unexpectedly

issues.description: Customers report the app stops working or won't connect even after reinstalling, and they feel support does not respond or resolve the problem.
issues.name: App fails to work and support unresponsive

issues.description: Users report that support is unreachable, chatbot-only, or unhelpful, leaving billing, cancellation, and technical problems unresolved.
issues.name: Unhelpful customer support and unresolved account issues

issues.description: Users report frequent, intrusive advertisements in the free and even paid experience, making listening annoying, costly in data, and hard to afford.
issues.name: Excessive ads interrupting music listening

issues.description: Users report the app forcing unwanted content, autoplay, notifications, sharing, and background activity they cannot disable, which wastes data and breaches their privacy.
issues.name: Unwanted features and intrusive app behavior

issues.description: Multiple users report that their playlists and liked songs were suddenly deleted or emptied, often after an update, with no way to recover them.
issues.name: Playlists and liked songs vanish unexpectedly

issues.description: Users report that shuffle cannot be disabled and the app plays suggested or different tracks instead of the song, playlist, or skip and replay controls they selected.
issues.name: Forced shuffle prevents playing chosen songs

issues.description: Customers report that recent updates made the interface hard to use, with missing controls, unresponsive screens, and basic features removed or hidden.
issues.name: Confusing or broken app interface after updates
